description: Retrospective application for erection of outbuilding and use as an annex
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposal would have a detrimental impact on the living conditions of the occupants at 58 Burnaby Gardens and 60 Burnaby Gardens, as a result of an increase in the number of comings and goings and intensification in the use of the site as a whole, leading to an unacceptable increase in noise and disturbance to neighbouring residents. The proposal would therefore not be in accordance SC4 of the Local Plan and contrary to Local Plan Policies CC1 (Context and Character) and SC7 (Residential Extensions and Alterations).

Condition : 2 - 2.	The use of the proposed outbuilding would not be incidental to the use of the dwellinghouse at 62 Burnaby Gardens and therefore the proposal represents inappropriate development that would harm neighbours' living conditions, contrary to Local plan policies CC2 and SC7 and the intent of the Residential Extension Guidelines. This would be contrary to Local Plan Policies CC1 (Context and Character); CC2 (Urban Design and Architecture) and SC7 (Residential Extensions and Alterations)
